title: ALPIDEX Women's Fleece Jacket — Stand-Up Collar, Thumb Holes, Tailored, Black
short_description: Tailored women's fleece jacket by ALPIDEX in black with a high stand-up collar, thumb holes and full zip.
long_description: This fleece jacket by ALPIDEX (model 16054) is available in black for women. According to Amazon it has a high stand-up collar with adjustable width, a full-length zip and outer pockets with YKK zips. The long sleeve cuffs have thumb holes and can be folded inwards when not needed. According to Amazon the cut is slightly tailored (fit: slim). Amazon describes the material as cuddly soft, breathable and pilling-free. The model wears size S and is 164 cm tall; choose your size using the measurements on the Amazon page. The jacket weighs 530 g according to Amazon. Before buying, please check size, colour and details on the Amazon product page.
